sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:47

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:47:1
items.html: Mocha Stimaa [the concealed brain] of AA, etc., in the aforementioned vowels of the second head, which are Segol in place of Tzere, etc.; in these, the vocalization of Patach instead of Kamatz: The meaning is that the place of the revelation of Hassadim in their root, which is through the coupling face to face of HB, is hinted at in the turning of the movement of Tzere to Segol, as above. And the discernments of the reception of the illumination of Hochma are hinted at in the turning of Kamatz to Patach, as above in the passage beginning “letters,” study it there well. And therefore the aspect of the Heys in the HaVaYaHs of Mocha Stimaa, which are the aspect of the Bina that turned from posterior to face, come also in Mocha Stimaa in the movement of Segol. And the Kamatzim that function in the HaVaYaHs of the air, which are the aspect of the Ketarim of the MA, which is Mocha Stimaa, are turned here to Patachin, whose meaning is that according to the size of the measure of the contracting that functions in the Keter of Mocha Stimaa, so is the size of the light opened in Mocha Stimaa, as above in the passage beginning “letters.” Study it there well.
